X01.title: Deal notional exceeds the dealer's per-deal limit
X01.detail: TS-005 dealt PKR 142m against a PKR 100m per-deal limit; TS-008 dealt PKR 231m against a PKR 150m limit.

X02.title: Dealer's aggregate dealing on one day exceeds the daily limit
X02.detail: TS-005 dealt five tickets of ~PKR 95m on 12 March 2025 - PKR 475m against a PKR 400m daily limit. Every ticket passes the per-deal test on its own.

X03.title: Counterparty exposure limit breached in aggregate
X03.detail: CP-005's book already stood at PKR 1,223,269,550 against a PKR 1,500,000,000 limit, or 82%. Four further placements struck on 19 February 2025, together PKR 381,730,450, carry it past the limit for the life of the tenor. Each of the four is around 6% of the limit and none is close to any per-deal threshold, so the breach exists only in the aggregate and only on a daily exposure profile. Thirteen deals in total are outstanding on the breached days.

X04a.title: Deal executed with a suspended counterparty
X04a.detail: CP-008 Northgate Bank was suspended with effect from 14 March 2025; both deals were struck after that date.

X04b.title: Deal executed after the counterparty's limit had expired
X04b.detail: CP-007's approved limit expired on 30 April 2025 and was not renewed.

X05a.title: Dealer transacted a product outside their authorisation
X05a.detail: TS-005 Bilal Ahmed is authorised for FX_SPOT only; both tickets are FX forwards.

X05b.title: Dealer transacted after their dealing authorisation had lapsed
X05b.detail: TS-010 Sana Tariq's authorisation expired on 31 May 2025; three June tickets follow it.

X07.title: Dealt rate outside the permitted deviation from the market mid
X07.detail: Two of the four are the same dealer (TS-005) with the same counterparty (CP-003), which is the pattern rather than the individual deal.

X09a.title: Deal struck outside authorised dealing hours
X09a.detail: Policy clause 5.2 permits dealing between 09:00 and 17:00 only.

X09b.title: Deal struck on a non-business day
X09b.detail: 12 April 2025 is a Saturday; the deal carries a market rate the file does not publish for that date.

X09c.title: Deal captured well after execution
X09c.detail: Capture lags execution by 47, 96 and 214 minutes against a 15-minute policy deadline.

X15.title: Near-duplicate deals booked on the same day
X15.detail: Same counterparty, notional, rate and value date, booked 90 minutes apart. Both settle.

X19.title: Deal cancelled without the required operations approval
X19.detail: Eight deals were cancelled in the period; six carry an operations approver and these two carry none.

X12.title: Deal amended after the counterparty confirmation was received, without approval
X12.detail: The amendment post-dates the matched confirmation and carries no operations approver.

C1.title: Deal booked against a different counterparty from the one it was struck with
C1.detail: Booked to CP-004 Horizon Bank. The counterparty confirmation in the pack is on Cedar Commercial Bank (CP-009) paper and carries Cedar's reference. Recorded CP-009 exposure peaks at PKR 922,000,000 against a limit of PKR 1,000,000,000; adding this PKR 120,000,000 deal takes it to PKR 1,042,000,000, or 104% of the limit. Invisible to every data test and to either document read alone.

C2.title: Rate on the counterparty confirmation differs from the rate booked
C2.detail: Booked at 279.5132, which is 1bp from the published mid of 279.4966 and so inside the 25bp policy band. The counterparty confirms 282.1686, which is 96bp from the same mid. The rate reasonableness test passes because it reads the recorded rate, not the confirmed one.

C3.title: Notional on the counterparty confirmation differs from the notional booked
C3.detail: Booked at PKR 205,000,000; the counterparty confirms PKR 230,000,000. The PKR 25m difference is neither settled nor recorded.

C4.title: A complete document pack exists for a deal the system never recorded
C4.detail: Deal ticket, broker note, counterparty confirmation, payment instruction and a nostro extract showing the funds leaving all exist for TD-2025-0447. The deal file skips that reference, no confirmation and no settlement row carries it, and the confirmation, instruction and settlement references on the paper are manual-series (CNF-2025-M041, PMT-2025-M0114, STL-2025-M014) that appear nowhere in the populations.

D1.title: Deal ticket carries no supervisory authorisation
D1.detail: The dealer signed; the authorisation block is blank. The system record shows nothing wrong.

D2.title: Rate on the deal ticket was altered and the alteration is not initialled
D2.detail: The ticket shows a struck-through rate over-written by hand. The booked rate matches the over-written figure, so no data test sees it.

D3.title: The counterparty confirmation is an internally produced document
D3.detail: The confirmation in the pack is a Meridian Bank internal print with no counterparty letterhead, no SWIFT header and no counterparty reference. The confirmation table records it as Matched.

D4.title: Broker note absent from the pack for a brokered deal
D4.detail: The deal records broker BR-001; the pack contains no broker note and brokerage was paid.

D5.title: Payment instruction released under a single signature above the dual-signature threshold
D5.detail: PKR 267,000,000 against a PKR 250m threshold. The settlement record names a second approver who did not sign the instruction.

D6.title: Supervisory authorisation on the deal ticket post-dates execution
D6.detail: The ticket was authorised two business days after the deal was struck and after the confirmation had been despatched.

OK.title: Packs with no exception
OK.detail: Complete, consistent packs. Included so the sample is not uniformly exceptional.

X16b.title: Deal reference does not follow the standard format
X16b.detail: Booked as TD-25-733 where every other reference in the file is TD-2025-nnnn. It sits in the sequence where TD-2025-0661 would fall.

X16a.title: Gaps in the deal reference sequence
X16a.detail: Four references are absent. TD-2025-0884 is the reference a settlement was released against; TD-2025-0447 is the deal a complete document pack exists for; TD-2025-0661 is empty because that deal was booked as TD-25-733; TD-2025-0612 is unexplained.

X08a.title: Deal captured and confirmed by the same person
X08a.detail: The dealer who struck and captured the deal also signed off the counterparty confirmation.

X08d.title: Confirmation signed off by a front-office member of staff
X08d.detail: The confirmer is not the dealer, so an identity test passes; the staff file places them on the dealing desk.

X08b.title: Settlement released and approved by the same person
X08b.detail: No second pair of eyes on release.

X08c.title: Settlement approved by the dealer who struck the deal
X08c.detail: Front office authorising the movement of its own funds.

X10a.title: Confirmation despatched outside the one-business-day deadline
X10a.detail: Despatched three to six business days after the deal.

X10b.title: Deal settled before the counterparty confirmation was received
X10b.detail: Funds moved on an unconfirmed deal; the confirmation arrived two business days after value date.

X10c.title: Deal settled while its confirmation was flagged as discrepant
X10c.detail: The discrepancy was never cleared and the settlement went ahead anyway.

X11.title: Settlement did not fall on the contracted value date
X11.detail: Two settled late by two and five business days; one settled a business day early.

X13.title: No confirmation record exists for a settled deal
X13.detail: The deal settled with nothing on file to show the counterparty agreed its terms.

X14a.title: Deal marked settled with no settlement record
X14a.detail: Nothing in the settlement file evidences that the funds moved.

X14b.title: Settlement recorded against a deal that does not exist
X14b.detail: PKR 185,000,000 released on 27 May 2025 against deal reference TD-2025-0884, which the deal file does not contain.

X17a.title: Settlement routed to an account with no standing instruction
X17a.detail: Both payments went to accounts absent from the SSI file, and both beneficiary banks differ from the counterparty's.

X17b.title: Settlement made inside the standing-instruction cooling-off period
X17b.detail: CP-006's PKR instruction was amended with effect from 2025-05-09 and paid on 2025-05-12, one business day later, against a two-business-day cooling-off requirement.

X18.title: Settlement amount does not agree to notional multiplied by the dealt rate
X18.detail: One overpaid by 1.8% and one underpaid by 0.9% against the contracted terms.

X06.title: Deals struck by a dealer with no row in the limit file
X06.detail: TS-009 Kamran Yousuf executed 61 T-bill deals in the period. The dealer limit file has no row for TS-009, so no deal of his can be tested for authority at all. This is an inconclusive result, not a pass and not a failure.

TD-2025-0384.DISCREPANCY_NOTE: Counterparty confirms value date one business day later than booked.

TD-2025-0386.DISCREPANCY_NOTE: Counterparty confirms a different tenor; unresolved at settlement.

TD-2025-0391.DISCREPANCY_NOTE: Counterparty reference not quoted; amount agreed verbally.
